run_pipeline_on_startup: run the Pipeline.on_startup method to load a GitHub repository into a Llama Index vector store
create_github_reader: create a GithubRepositoryReader to load source code files from a GitHub repository while excluding image and binary extensions
build_query_engine: build a streaming query engine from a Llama Index vector store to answer questions over repository content
pipe_user_query: pipe a user query through the Pipeline.pipe method to retrieve relevant information via RAG
configure_ollama_settings: configure Ollama embedding and LLM settings for a Llama Index pipeline with nomic-embed-text and llama3
